notes.title: Patch 1.5 is live! New sensitivity scales!
notes.content:
Hey guys!

Patch 1.5 is live! Here are some of the changes.

New mouse sensitivity scales

Mouse sensitivity scales for Apex Legends and Escape from Tarkov have been added! Check them out on the control settings menu!

Fixes and changes:


 Fixed minor bugs
 Fixed a bug that made the Recoil Level 9 button stop working
 Changed the animation speed for the menus
 Added mouse sensitivity scales for Apex Legends and Escape from Tarkov

notes.title: Patch 1.4 is live! New features!
notes.content:
Hey guys!

Patch 1.4 is here and brings more features requested by the community.

New - Leaning

You can now lean left or right, much like in other FPS games! Default key bindings for leaning are "Q" and "E", but you can change that in the settings. Also, the "Interact" action default binding has been changed to "F". There's also the option to toggle or hold for leaning in the Control Settings Menu.

New - Randomized spawn points for Advanced Mode

In this patch, randomized spawn points have been introduced in all Advanced Levels. This should add more replayability to those levels, and make them a bit harder as well, to help train your skills even more!

New - Headshots Only option for the Custom Endless Mode

Custom Endless Mode now has a new option to count only headshots. This means that body shots won't do any damage, forcing you to hit only headshots. This option should help train your aim even better!

I hope you all enjoy these changes, and thank you for playing!

Cheers!

Full list of changes:


Fixed a bug that would let the player change the sights while in ADS
Fixed a bug that would keep the item change message on screen after the player moved away from the item
Fixed a bug that would make the camera "snap" in certain positions
Fixed a bug that would cause the aim to be misaligned under some conditions
Added leaning
Added key mapping settings for leaning
Added toggle option for leaning
Added randomized spawn points to all Advanced levels
Added "Headshots Only" option to the Custom Endless Mode

notes.title: Patch 1.3 is live! New game mode!
notes.content:
Hello, guys! Happy new year!

Patch 1.3 is here, and with it comes new features requested by the community.

New - Custom Endless Mode

In this mode you can customize many options to create your own version of the Endless Mode! Want something more laid back? Turn off the enemy A.I. or make yourself invincible! Or maybe you want more control on how much time you have or which weapons you use? Change that too!

Also, if you have more ideas of settings to add to this mode, feel free to send your feedback on the forums.

I hope you guys enjoy this new mode!

New - Gameplay Settings Menu

There is also a new settings menu, with options requested by the community. In the Gameplay Settings Menu you can find settings for showing the points message on screen, making the player character left handed, and the Field of View setting, which has been moved from the Control Settings Menu.

Same as with the new mode, if you have ideas for more settings please let me know.

Anyway, I hope you guys have fun on this new patch, and have a great 2019! :)

Full list of changes:

 Fixed a bug that destroying the last target with the last bullet would cause a fail
 Fixed a bug that would reset some settings when changing key mappings
 Fixed a bug that would cause a crash in certain situations
 Fixed a bug that would let the game run in an unsupported resolution
 Added key mapping settings for movement keys
 Added settings for showing the points message for each game mode
 Added option to make the player character left handed
 Moved the FOV setting to the new Gameplay Settings menu
 Added new Custom Endless Mode to the Extra Levels

notes.title: Patch 1.2 is live!
notes.content:
Hey guys!

Patch 1.2 is live! Corrected a few bugs and included some suggestions from the community. More content coming soon! Thank you for your feedback and keep it coming!

Fixes and changes:
